title: Settings
intro: The shop's name and how it works. The name appears on the receipt, above the menu, in the browser tab and on the login screen.

form.shopNameHint: This is the name printed on the receipt. Left empty, the previous name is used.
form.nasiyaHint: Off: no new debt can be opened, and Qarzdorlik disappears once every existing debt is settled. Existing debts stay visible and collectable.

errors.saveFailed: Could not save. Please try again.

featuresIntro: Which features this shop uses. A feature switched off disappears from the menu and from the forms.

click.cashboxHint: Says which till this is. Leave empty if Click does not ask for one.
click.checkChecksSaved: The check looks at what is saved.
click.checkNeedsSave: There are unsaved changes — save first, then check.
click.checkNoCharge: This check creates no payment and does not contact Click.
click.confirmClear: The secret key will be deleted and Click will be switched off — the till will stop taking Click payments. Continue?
click.enabledHint: Off: no Click button appears at the till. It cannot be switched on until the details are filled in.
click.intro: This shop's Click merchant details. Each installation has its own. The secret key is stored encrypted and is never shown back.
click.secretKeepHint: A key is stored. Leaving this empty changes nothing; type a new one to replace it.
click.secretNewHint: Paste the secret key from your Click cabinet.
click.secretStored: Stored — leave empty to keep it
click.title: Click Pass — payment provider
